title: ci(test): store junit results for unit tests
body:
**Summary**

Junit summary can be used to give a clean output in CircleCI of which tests have failed

**Result**

* adds jest-junit
* sets up junit report on CircleCI

example for the report: https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch.js/6317/workflows/428b121b-6129-4a5e-8397-335e8b4d8f33/jobs/30004/tests
